parsed.notes:
The qualifications section defaults to required; no optional skills section appears. The general encouragement to apply without every qualification does not change labels.
Concrete alternatives illustrating LLM-building experience are included as required skills under the examples rule.
Integrating models into production systems is provisionally mapped to AI deployment; integration does not unambiguously mean deployment, so this mapping is flagged.
Workflow development is left unmapped rather than assuming workflow automation. Prototyping and technical enablement have no matching taxonomy entries.
Job-role names in the experience requirement are treated literally as experience backgrounds, not additional named technical practices. Technologies and practices appearing only in responsibilities or company descriptions are excluded.
